# ghost/redreader

Read public Reddit posts and comments through anonymous RedReader. Search a subreddit, list titles/scores/comment counts and summarize visible text without login or engagement.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/redreader
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/redreader open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/redreader browse_subreddit --device <serial> --param subreddit=<subreddit>
ghost skill run ghost/redreader search_posts --device <serial> --param subreddit=<subreddit> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/redreader read_posts --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/redreader open_post --device <serial> --param index=<index>
ghost skill run ghost/redreader read_thread --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/redreader back_to_posts --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the public anonymous main menu
- `browse_subreddit`: Open a public subreddit and read visible posts
- `search_posts`: Search a public subreddit and read visible matching posts
- `read_posts`: Read current public listing as structured post metadata
- `open_post`: Open comments for one visible post without opening its external link
- `read_thread`: Read visible post body and comments without account or engagement
- `back_to_posts`: Return from a thread to its public post listing
